_comment: tool/SPEC_ui_retro.md section 9: asset id -> path relative to tool/assets/. Circuit cards are NOT here -- their images are generated (render.brain_panel.highlight_populations, section 8), never user-supplied, so they never need a placeholder fallback. See tool/assets/README.md for what to actually supply. Card images point at tool/assets/sprites/, the full SMB1 sprite set downloaded from the Super Mario Wiki (Category:Super_Mario_Bros._assets) with original file names kept; that folder is gitignored (Nintendo art stays local). To use another sprite for a card, or add a new entity, point an id at any file in sprites/.
